attributes.name: font pairing system
attributes.definition: How typeface classes (sans-serif vs serif) are combined across the page's text elements.

values.definition: Both a sans-serif stack and a serif face are used, each covering a substantial share of elements.
Serif is the main typeface; sans used sparingly.
Sans-serif is the main typeface; serif used sparingly (e.g. headings only).
Monospace, display, or other combination not covered.
